per_query.label: lat+long
per_query.question: What is the geographic location of this oil and gas facility based on its WGS84 coordinates?
per_query.answer:
The facility (Ahuroa South B‑1 well site) is located in the **Taranaki Basin on the west coast of New Zealand’s North Island**, at approximately **39° 16′ 01.20″ S, 174° 20′ 25.38″ E** (WGS84-style lat/long given in the report). These coordinates place it **near the Taranaki region (south of Auckland and northwest of Wellington)**.  
Source: page 13 (coordinates and basin location description) and page 95 (same coordinates).

per_query.label: openv ID
per_query.question: What is the operating environment of this oil and gas asset?
per_query.answer:
The asset (Ahuroa South B-1 / Ahuroa South B-1 ST1) operates in the **Taranaki Basin, New Zealand**, a **tectonically active convergent-plate boundary setting** between the **Australian Plate and Pacific Plate**. The basin is largely **offshore (~90%)**, with an onshore portion buried beneath **Quaternary volcanic and alluvial deposits**, and it includes an **Eastern Mobile Belt** (where proven hydrocarbon accumulations occur) and a less-deformed **Western Stable Platform**. **Seals are typically marine mudstones** (e.g., Manganui mudstones in the Ahuroa/Piakau area).  
(Source: p.13, p.14, p.21)
